admit_policy_unavailable_root_cause.server_http_status_in_run: All 7 NATIVE_FACT_TRACE HTTP requests from codex-channel-octo to octo-server returned http_status=200 (zero HTTP 400 in that run). Both bind_live_ingress and register_ingress (resolve purpose=admit on l1-... before trigger persistence) succeeded.
admit_policy_unavailable_root_cause.bundle_fetch_status: During handleControl(admit) in octo-cli/internal/mcp/permission_host.go, GET /v1/bot/permission-bundle/v1 and ParseBundle succeeded (any error there returns status='unavailable', reason='authority_unavailable', whereas admit returned status='refused', category='policy_unavailable').
admit_policy_unavailable_root_cause.refusal_location: octo-cli/internal/permission/coordinator.go:1936-1938 -> compiledFixturePolicy.validBundle(p) (coordinator.go:1805-1831 in 7a1ca54a5a4dbbfad3d329fab9e5cca28390ffc6), configured by IsolatedTestFixturePolicy() in octo-cli/internal/mcp/permission_bootstrap.go:666-698.
admit_policy_unavailable_root_cause.exact_mechanism: In 7a1ca54a5a4dbbfad3d329fab9e5cca28390ffc6, IsolatedTestFixturePolicy() placed write capabilities (octo-cli/docs/op/docs.create, octo-cli/docs/op/docs.scene.edit, octo-cli/docs/op/docs.scene.get) in DeniedCapabilities (absent from fp.allowed), and compiledFixturePolicy.validBundle(p) rejected the entire bundle at Stage 1 Admit time with status='refused', category='policy_unavailable' whenever any rule in p.Capability.Rules with effect=='allow' contained a capability ID outside fp.allowed. When XIN-2858 switched revision 9 to 'permitted/writes-allowed' via fixture.py, the bundle included write capabilities in an allow rule, causing compiledFixturePolicy.validBundle(p) in octo-cli 7a1ca54a to refuse Stage 1 Admit (repaired in XIN-2794 c23aedbb10a425655dd63b89c68175affb102273).

intermittent_native_facts_http_400_root_.d14_transport_mapping: Under D14 legacy transport compatibility (pkg/httperr/respond.go:22-72), permissionbundle.RespondError maps all permissionbundle.Error values — including ErrUnavailable (err.server.mcp.policy_unavailable, semantic 503) and ErrReconcile (err.server.mcp.reconcile_failed, semantic 503) — to HTTP transport status 400 on the wire.

defect_1_for_share_nowait_innodb_lock_ab.cause: ServerMessageFactProvider, SQLNativeFactAdapter, SQLNative, Store.read(SHARE), and Runtime.commitAssociations appended FOR SHARE NOWAIT on shared MySQL tables (message..message4, bot_permission_scope, group, user, robot). Under live WukongIM webhook traffic (POST /v1/webhook?event=msg.notify executing INSERT INTO message{N} ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE payload=payload) or concurrent scope updates, overlapping bind_live_ingress and resolve queries aborted immediately with MySQL Error 3572 (ER_LOCK_NOWAIT) instead of waiting a few milliseconds for the short row write to commit, mapping to ErrUnavailable -> HTTP 400.
defect_1_for_share_nowait_innodb_lock_ab.fix: Replaced FOR SHARE NOWAIT on shared read queries (server_message_facts.go, native_facts_adapter.go, native_sql.go, store.go lock=='SHARE', runtime.go commitAssociations, and authority_fence.go forUpdate==false) with bounded FOR SHARE governed by the existing 2-second context deadline, while preserving FOR UPDATE NOWAIT on exclusive write locks.

defect_2_double_authority_begin_per_requ.cause: Runtime.Facts and Runtime.BindDeliveredMessage called r.store.begin(ctx) (which invoked s.Authority.Begin(ctx, tx) #1, allocating Position N+1), and then SQLNativeFactAdapter.Read / BindDeliveredMessage called a.Authority.Begin(ctx, tx) #2 on the same transaction t.tx (allocating Position N+2 and returning sql.position='N+2' on the wire). When complete(ctx, t) ran, t.authority.Complete(ctx) only acknowledged Position N+1, leaving committed_position (N+2) > acknowledged_position (N+1) after every permission-facts call and advancing sql.position by 2 per request.
defect_2_double_authority_begin_per_requ.fix: Added withActiveAuthorityRead(ctx, t.tx, t.authority) in native_facts_adapter.go and native_wire.go so SQLNativeFactAdapter.Read and BindDeliveredMessage reuse the outer transaction's already-begun AuthorityRead. Each permission-facts call now allocates and acknowledges exactly 1 monotonic SQL authority position with committed_position == acknowledged_position == reported sql.position.

defect_3_lineage_latch_on_context_cancel.cause: NativeSingleWriterLineageDriver permanently latched in-memory d.failed=true even when readSQLRow or post-commit RecordAcknowledgedPosition failed solely because the caller's HTTP request context was canceled (e.g., client timeout/disconnect), poisoning all subsequent requests with ErrUnavailable (HTTP 400) until process restart. In addition, Runtime.commitAssociations bypassed FencedAuthorityAdapter.acquireTxGate(ctx).
defect_3_lineage_latch_on_context_cancel.fix: In authority_fence.go, AcquireCurrent and AssertCurrent only latch d.failed=true when ctx.Err()==nil; RecordAcknowledgedPosition runs its post-commit checkpoint update under context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(ctx), 2*time.Second); and Runtime.commitAssociations acquires acquireTxGate(ctx) before beginning its transaction.

wire_compatibility_with_cli_c23aedbb_and.fix: parseDeliveryBindingRequest (bind_live_ingress / bind_delivery) and validateEvaluateCurrentAccessRequest (evaluate_current_access) accept optional profile_version=1 and canonical DM pair channel_id values up to 400 chars, preserving exact compatibility with both codex-channel-octo fa7896a845aaab16fdda926b4b406dfa47a3a3e4 and octo-cli c23aedbb10a425655dd63b89c68175affb102273.
